odometry_topic: /odometry/filtered twist.linear.x (the MPC measured speed); /odom reported alongside (/odometry/filtered tracks /odom sample-for-sample: vx_variance 0)
command_topic: /ackermann_drive (mux output) when complete in the bag, else /drive; identical where both exist
timebase: header stamps; car-recorded bags: receive - stamp median 1-14 ms, p95 <= 21 ms. The 10-19 corridor bag was recorded off-car (p95 0.2-1.2 s), so stamps, not receive times, are used everywhere.
units: u, y in m/s at speed_to_erpm_gain 4516.9 (today); runs at 5499.27 are pooled in ERPM
model: drive regime (u >= 500 ERPM = 0.111 m/s): y[k+1] = a y[k] + (1-a) K(u) u[k-d], a = exp(-dt/tau); K(u) = K1 (1 - u0/u) (offset model).  Below ~500 ERPM the VESC gives no drive current.

d_evidence.note: closed-loop d selection is biased to 0 (u[k] contains the sample v_hold[k]); the CT fit even prefers non-causal theta < 0. The exogenous evidence is the stops (u -> 0).

nominal.tau_basis: median over archive runs of the IV (2SLS) one-step fit at d=0, exact ZOH; CI = bootstrap over runs
nominal.euler_note: Euler a = 1 - ts/tau needs tau_euler = ts/(1-a): at tau 0.17 s, a = exp(-0.1/0.17) = 0.56 equals Euler with tau_euler = 0.226 s; use the exact form at ts = 0.1

timebase.note: campaign recorder t = header stamp (receive time if stamp > 5 s off)
